title: Identity contracts
description: Definition identity and runtime identities (03 §2, §3, §6; 05 §4). Each id is its own named type; the types are not interchangeable (03 §6).

DefinitionRef.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition (03 §2; 05 §4: no global content-key namespace). cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

DefinitionRefString.description: Canonical string form of a DefinitionRef, cartridge_id@cartridge_version:kind/key (03 §2, 05 §4), with the same segment rules: each at most 64 characters, so every valid DefinitionRef has a valid string form.

WorldContextId.description: Logical world/context identity: the simulation, save or deployment context in which state exists (03 §6, 'Logical world identity is not mutation-owner placement'). Never a fencing, owner or shard token. Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

AuthorityDomainId.description: The current serialized mutation-ownership domain (03 §6). Distinct from WorldContextId: one logical world can hold many authority domains. Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

ZoneShardId.description: One Realm placement/routing identity for an authority domain (03 §6). Player and party scope are not permanently owned by it. Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

RealmId.description: The broader persistent Realm identity (03 §6); the id of realm StateScope. Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

EntityId.description: Runtime entity identity (03 §3). Two entities from one DefinitionRef have different EntityIds. Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

CommandId.description: Stable semantic Command id (04 §3), derived from the logical idempotency scope and the InvocationId; stable when the AuthorityDomainId changes (03 §6). Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

InvocationId.description: Client-visible stable retry identity of one ActionInvocation (04 §1, §2). Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

CharacterId.description: A character (02 §4); the id of player StateScope and player AudiencePolicy (03 §6). Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.

PartyId.description: A party; the id of party StateScope and party AudiencePolicy (03 §6). Lowercase hyphenated UUID, any version.
